title: Whose doctor does the AI recommend? An algorithm audit of reputation and demographic signals in large language model–assisted physician choice

bias_targets.methodology: Randomized choice-based conjoint audit using counterfactual name substitution on synthetic physician profiles to signal male or female gender.
Randomized choice-based conjoint audit using correspondence-audit methodology, substituting physician names to signal White, Black, Hispanic, East Asian, and South Asian identities.
Randomizing the display order (slots 1-5) of physician cards independently of their content to measure content-free list-position advantage.
